Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.title: The Midwich Cuckoos EP1
programme.desc: Seluruh penduduk Midwich pengsan secara misteri. Selepas sedar, kesan aneh mula timbul terutama dalam kalangan wanita.

programme.title: Janin Iblis Neraka
programme.desc: Sepasang suami isteri, Dika (Samuel Rizal) dan Ranti (Aliyah Faizah), tinggal di rumah baharu. Kekacauan dalam kehidupan pasangan itu mula muncul apabila Ranti mengandung dan anak yang dikandungnya adalah janin syaitan.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP1
programme.desc: Pengantara Saiful Azmi Jamsari berkongsi pengalaman semasa merakamkan beberapa episod Detik 12 Malam sebelum ini. Antaranya Episod 1 Musim 1 bertajuk Kisah Penggali Kubur. Beliau terlihat asap berkepul-kelul semasa menggali kubur semasa rakaman. Episod 2 Musim 2, Bertajuk Pemandu Kenderaan Jenazah. Pengantara memandu sendiri van tersebut dan dilihat kain meliput jenazah diterbalikkan. Episod 12 Musim1, Petugas Bilik Mayat. Pengantara berkongsi pengalaman apabila melihat kemunculan lembaga. Episod 9 Musim 2, bertajuk Muzium Perang. Pengantara ternampak patung dalam muzium perang tibatiba- tiba seakan-akan kepalanya bergerak. Episod 3 Musim 1, bertajuk Renjer Hutan. Beliau bertugas sebagai renjer hutan, diganggu oleh saka masyarakat orang asli. Pengantara melihat sendiri makhluk halus melalui kawasan tersebut

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP1
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 12 tahun lalu di sebuah Kg Kuala Pari Hilir. Tiga kanak-kanak bersahabat iaitu Yeh Kumbang, Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi perlu melintasi rumah Wan Peah selepas mengaji Quran. Wan Peah dikatakan seorang yang misteri, tinggal sendirian, mengamal ilmu hitam dan sering mengganggu kanak-kanak ini. Tok Hashim sebagai ketua kampung mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Faan yang selalu bermain dengan Yeh, Gani dan Li. Suatu hari semasa bermain menyorok berhampiran dengan rumah Wan Peah, Faan dia telah dibawa lari oleh Wan Peah masuk ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Kamu Tidak Sendiri
programme.desc: Satu malam di pejabat bertukar menjadi mimpi ngeri apabila seorang wanita terperangkap dalam lif selepas gempa bumi besar.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP1
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa dari sebuah NGO masuk ke kampung untuk membantu Bayu yang menjadi mangsa rogol. Insiden tersebut mengingatkan Lisa kejadian yang sama pernah berlaku kepadanya 7 tahun lalu di rogol oleh sekumpulan lelaki bertopeng. Bayu kemudiannya meninggal dunia. Mbah Ngai dibantu oleh Afifa membantu Siti anak Pak Samad yang sedang kemurungan. Afifa mengambil kesempatan, kononnya Siti terkena ilmu hitam. Pak Samad membayar sejumlah wang upahan kepada Afifa bagi membalas dendam perbuatan bomoh tersebut. Mbah Ngai menjaga Sarah anak kepada Afifa yang mengalami tekanan. Nasrun bersama kumpulannya membuat onak di kampong tersebut, mereka yang menculik Bayu dan membunuhnya. Kumpulan ini diketuai oleh Pak Samad. Manakala Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, emak kepada Bayu. Manakala Lisa bersama Syamil seorang bekas Inspektor meneruskan siasatan mereka bagi menangkap perogol Bayu.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa bersama Syamil balik ke kampong untuk membantu Mak Leha menyiasat kejadian anaknya Bayu yang mati selepas dirogol. Mereka singgah di rumah Mbah Hira untuk berjumpa dengan Afifa dan Sarah. Syamil terpaksa meninggalkan mereka selepas di marahi oleh Afifa. Lisa berkongsi maklumat tentang kejadian rogol yang menimpa dirinya, Afifa, Sarah dan Bayu. Nasrun di ugut oleh Azhar, Caryl dan Bakri kerana cuba lari dari kumpulan mereka. Kumpulan perogol membuar perancangan untuk merogol cucu Pak Samad. Mbah Hari marahkan Afifa kerana menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, dia berusaha mengubati kaki Mak Leha. Sebaliknya, Afifa meminta sejumpalh wang dari Mak Leha kerana mereka mengubati kaki Mak Leha yang telah menjadi busuk.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mbah Ngai marahkan Afifa kerana mengugut Mak Leha bagi mendapatkan wang kononnya bagi meyembuhkan kakinya yang busuk. Kumpulan Azhar merancang untuk merogol Siti, cucu kepada Pak Samad dengan menggunakan Nasrun. Nasrun menghadiahkan seutas jam, dia juga menawarkan pekerjaan kepada Pak Samad untuk keluar bekerja di luar kawasan supaya Siti tinggal keseorangan. Nasrun bersama kumpulannya berlakon menyampaikan bantuan kepada penduduk kampong, Lisa ternampak Nasrun yang pernah merogolnya 7 tahun lalu. Dr. Caryl masih berlakon sebagai doktor yang baik untuk membantu Mak Habshah dan Bayu, Nasrun Berjaya menculik Siti lalu di bawa kepada kumpulannya untuk dijadikan sebagai mangsa rogol. Namun Siti sempat melarikan diri sebelum dia dirogol

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP4
programme.desc: Kumpulan Hunter berjaya menangkap Siti semula, lalu merogolnya. Syamil menunjukkan gambar Nasrun kepadanya Lisa, dia memberitahu Afifa yang dia syak Nasrun dan rakan-rakannya adalah perogol mereka 7 tahun lalu. Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitamnya ke atas Nasrun, namun Mbah Ngai merampas peralatan tersebut. Imbas kembali 7 tahun lalu, Afifa, Sara dan Lisa diserang Kumpulan Hunter yang bertopeng, mereka menculik dan merogol mereka. Lisa keluar bersama Afifa ke rumah kosong lokasi mereka pernah di rogol. Tiba-tiba mereka ternampak Siti terbaring keseorangan. Pada tangan Siti terdapat segumpal rambut perogolnya. Mereka membawa Siti balik untuk berjumpa dengan Pak Samad yang kebetulan baru sampai. Lisa ternampak seutas jam di bilik Siti, kebetulan jam yang sama pernah di terima oleh Lisa satu masa lalu. Manakala Afifa menggunakan sihir ke atas pemilik rambut yang diambil dari tangan Siti. Bakri tiba-tiba muntah darah semasa meraikan kejayaan mereka bersama Caryl dan Azhar

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP15
programme.desc: Alia dan Susan tertangkap. Adam sempat meyelamatkan mereka yang hampir dibunuh Dr Zahir. Zacky turut terselamat manakala Dr Zahir ditahan polis. Ritz yang dalam tahanan lelaki bertopeng dipaksa memanggil Alia datang kelokasi mereka. Lelaki bertopeng memanggil Adam datang kelokasi yang sama. Zacky tiba dilokasi bersama Alia. Berlaku pertarungan antara Zacky dan lelaki bertopeng. Adam menembak kaki lelaki bertopeng untuk menyelamatkan Zacky. Dalam masa yang sama Alia dan Kai pergi menyelamatkan Ritz. Mereka semua terkejut apabila mendapati lelaki bertopeng itu sebenarnya Rafeeq yang juga adik kembar Adam. Mereka berdua bersaing dalam misi membalas dendam terhadap Tan Seri Jalaludin yang telah merampas harta dan membunuh ibu bapa mereka. Adam menembak Rafeeq sebelum menembak Tan Seri Jalaludin. Selepas kejadian Adam meminta Zacky menyerahkanya kepada pihak berkuasa

Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati

Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. Filem ini menggambarkan bagaimana pasangan perlu memahami, bertolak ansur dan menerima kekurangan masing-masing dalam membina hubungan yang lebih erat.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Mila, seorang wanita yang mempunyai pandangan tersendiri mengenai hubungan dan cinta, yang berdepan dengan perbezaan cara berfikir antara lelaki dan wanita. Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai “pintu menuju surga” selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut

programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

programme.desc: Persahabatan antara dua orang gadis, Pelangi dan Nirmala. Namun, persahabatan mereka ditentang oleh orang tua mereka kerana perbezaan strata sosial. Pelangi hidup dengan sederhana, sementara Nirmala hidup mewah.

Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.desc: Wicak (Erdin Werdrayana) pulang ke sebuah desa untuk mencari ibunya yang telah lama terpisah. Di sana, dia bertemu Nindi (Ochi Rosdiana), penjaga vila tempatnya menginap, yang sudi membantunya menjejaki ibunya. Sepanjang pencarian itu, mereka semakin rapat dan tanpa disedari mula menyimpan perasaan antara satu sama lain.

Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Liza's On Line (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Liza Wang, Sammy Leung, William So, and Dickson Yu have teamed up to create a game show, inviting members of the entertainment family and guests to participate in a "Werewolf Palace Edition" game, revealing their foolish and clever sides. Guests will also tell exaggerated "true or false stories" to attract attention, allowing for speculation on whether the events are real or fake! Following her magical touch from the previous season, Ah Jie will again stir up topics at the "Cheat Chat" dinner table. Who can bring the most entertainment? Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes!

programme.title: Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026
programme.desc: Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026: Hunan Moments follows the top 12 contestants as they travel to Hengyang, Hunan for intensive training and outdoor filming.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

programme.title: Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: They are young. They are bold. They sweat. They fall in love - on the beach. YIP CHING (YEO VIVIEN), YIP KIU (LI SZE YAN) and YIP YAN (CHEN CHI YIU) are sisters. When they were young, they met a Gypsy girl (YUNG CHO YEE, JOEY) who foresaw that CHING would meet her true love, who has a four-leafed clover birthmark, when she turns eighteen. In the blink of an eye, the sisters have grown up and are now sixth-formers at the Greenwood International School. The beach volleyball team captain YUE YAT SUN (SZETO SHUI KI), a star student, is handsome and cheerful. Many girls join the team just for him. The sisters see a four-leafed clover birthmark which matches the description given by the Gypsy girl on SUN from three different angles. However, CHING is indecisive and lacks confidence. KIU and YAN are busy trying to set up chances for her to be with SUN. The three sisters join the beach volleyball team. Remarkably, they also find the same birthmark on a bad student named NIC FONG (CHoi KAY CHUN). The sisters are confused, unsure about who is CHING's true love…

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Time Of Love 2 - Germany, A
programme.desc: Crystal (Charmaine Sheh), a high-ranking company executive, has been dating her subordinate Oscar (Kenneth Ma) for a year, and they travel to Germany together on a business trip. Oscar, seeing his girlfriend's constant indulgence, becomes acutely aware of the disparity in their financial capabilities… This "female superiority, male inferiority" mentality impacts their love. Is happiness truly linked to economic ability?

programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

programme.title: Time Of Love 2 - Germany, A
programme.desc: Crystal (Charmaine Sheh), a high-ranking company executive, has been dating her subordinate Oscar (Kenneth Ma) for a year, and they travel to Germany together on a business trip. Oscar, seeing his girlfriend's constant indulgence, becomes acutely aware of the disparity in their financial capabilities… This "female superiority, male inferiority" mentality impacts their love. Is happiness truly linked to economic ability?

programme.title: Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: They are young. They are bold. They sweat. They fall in love - on the beach. YIP CHING (YEO VIVIEN), YIP KIU (LI SZE YAN) and YIP YAN (CHEN CHI YIU) are sisters. When they were young, they met a Gypsy girl (YUNG CHO YEE, JOEY) who foresaw that CHING would meet her true love, who has a four-leafed clover birthmark, when she turns eighteen. In the blink of an eye, the sisters have grown up and are now sixth-formers at the Greenwood International School. The beach volleyball team captain YUE YAT SUN (SZETO SHUI KI), a star student, is handsome and cheerful. Many girls join the team just for him. The sisters see a four-leafed clover birthmark which matches the description given by the Gypsy girl on SUN from three different angles. However, CHING is indecisive and lacks confidence. KIU and YAN are busy trying to set up chances for her to be with SUN. The three sisters join the beach volleyball team. Remarkably, they also find the same birthmark on a bad student named NIC FONG (CHoi KAY CHUN). The sisters are confused, unsure about who is CHING's true love…

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

Through lively food challenges, scenic explorations, and authentic local encounters, the hosts bring audiences closer to Taiwans diverse flavors and vibrant traditions.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby; a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge; some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK$200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse “Red Hare” to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, “Red Hare” may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families. From the struggles at home to challenges in relationships and conflicts at work, these three women rise with strength when faced with plights unknown.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing has been able to see ghosts since young. When his mother's suicide attempt forces him to return to Hong Kong and the home he ran away from, he discovers that the horrific visions that once haunted him have become worse. Caught between the living and the dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly “Iron Fist” technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Arasangam
programme.desc: Arivarasu goes to Canada to search for his missing brother-in-law. However, he discovers a plot by terrorists to kill all intellectuals in India and stop the country's growth.

programme.title: Hotspot 2 Much
programme.desc: An aspiring director presents three compelling stories that shed light on pressing social and ideological issues, sparking thought and meaningful conversations.

programme.title: Pattathu Yaanai
programme.desc: Saravanan and his friends come to Trichy to set up a new restaurant business. However, their plans get interrupted when he gets an order from a local gangster but falls for his girlfriend, Aishwarya.

programme.title: Game Changer
programme.desc: Ram Nandan, a government official, embarks on a relentless fight against corrupt politicians. Determined to bring about fair elections, he tries to revolutionise the way the government operates.

programme.title: Mazaka
programme.desc: Carefree friends Karthik, Rishi and Mani stumble into hilarious situations as friendship and romance complicate their lives.

programme.title: 777 Charlie
programme.desc: In a life filled with loneliness, a grumpy guy's world flips when a mischievous pup named Charlie bursts in, shaking things up and bringing joy into his days.

programme.title: Maaman
programme.desc: An uncle and nephew navigate their strained bond and family dynamics through challenging circumstances that test their connection.

programme.title: Kuttram 23
programme.desc: ACP Vetrimaaran unravels a crime racket involving medical professionals. However, his task becomes harder every day as the case becomes murkier and complex.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Hernandez vs. Rodrigues - Main
programme.desc: UFC returns to Sacramento for the first time in seven years on Saturday, August 23, bringing a UFC Fight Night event to Golden 1 Center headlined by a meeting between ranked middleweights Anthony “Fluffy” Hernandez and Gregory “Robocop” Rodrigues. A NorCal native, Hernandez collected finishes over Edmen Shahbazyan, Michel Pereira, and Roman Dolidze during the course of an eight-fight winning streak that was halted earlier this year by current champ Sean Strickland. Fighting out of Deerfield Beach, Florida, the 34-year-old Rodrigues pushed his winning streak to three with a first-round knockout win over Brunno Ferreira at UFC 326 and has won eight of his last 10 overall.

programme.title: LALIGA TOP MOMENTS GERARD PIQUE - LALIGA TOP MOMENTS GERARD PIQUE
programme.desc: A towering presence at the back and a potent attacking force upfront. Complete domination by Barcelona club captain Gerard Pique.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Nurmagomedov vs. Song - Main
programme.desc: UFC heads back to Shanghai this summer with a fight card at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center on Saturday, August 29 headlined by a crucial pairing in the bantamweight division as Umar Nurmagomedov takes on “The Kung Fu Kid” Song Yadong. Nurmagomedov carries a 20-1 record into second main event assignment, having earned consecutive wins over Deiveson Figueiredo and Mario Bautista since coming up short on his attempt to claim the bantamweight title. The 28-year-old Song makes his second consecutive headlining turn in his home country, looking to build off his second-round submission win over Figueiredo in Macau in May while collecting the biggest win of his career.

programme.title: UFC Main Event - UFC 304: Edwards vs Muhammad 2

programme.title: Mencari Ramli Musim Ke - 4 - 4
